<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/resources/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Automatically identifies the resource type based on the globally unique resource ID. Protocol resources return properties, schema, and read-only health. 

The properties field does not include sensitive fields such as token, password, secret, credential, privateKey, or apiKey. Protocol directories, networks, devices, and points return protocolId. Both reading and modifying only require id. 

The business deviceId and controlReference are only returned as determined by device visibility, authorization, and mapping. For context of discovery tasks, refer to the Resource Scenario Guide.
